briefdescription.para: An information struct used to provide DenseMap with the various necessary components for a given value type T.

detaileddescription.para: Enable is an optional additional parameter that is used to support SFINAE (generally using std::enable_if_t) in derived DenseMapInfo specializations; in non-SFINAE use cases this should just be void.
